Treatment summary
Patient presented following a collision in which the vehicle was struck while making a
left turn. The reported mechanism is consistent with the knee injury described, and
the force involved is in keeping with the structures affected. Care was delivered over
29 visits, beginning with conservative management including physical therapy, activity
modification, and anti-inflammatory medication. Progress was steady, and visit
frequency was reduced in a stepwise fashion as symptoms and range of motion improved.
On examination, some findings, including effusion and pain with specific loading
maneuvers, support the presence of an injury to the knee. Other provocative tests and
neurovascular assessments were within normal limits. Records note a remote, minor
strain involving the same region from several years ago, which had resolved completely
without lasting limitation. Billing records reflect single entries for each service
without duplicate or repeated charges. The patient was discharged to self-directed
home exercise with instructions to return if symptoms recur.

address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
